name: Yardi Matrix
description: Ask straightforward questions about properties, markets and portfolios to get the answers you need from Yardi Matrix. Search properties by location, owner or risk profile; pull rent trends and occupancy metrics; benchmark portfolios against their markets; surface distressed assets and acquisition opportunities; and generate data-rich market intelligence reports. Yardi Matrix is designed for analysts, investors and asset managers who need reliable real estate data quickly to make informed decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yardi Matrix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yardi Matrix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://matrixmcp.virtuoso.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yardi Matrix MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Matrix lists 33 MCP tools, including get_dataset_summary, validate_data_quality, get_schema_info, get_query_guidance, search_data_types, get_property_ids, search_properties, search_by_owner, fetch_property_unit_mix, fetch_property_demographics, fetch_financial_forecast, and find_distressed_assets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yardi Matrix?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Yardi Matrix in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Yardi Matrix MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Matrix requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yardi Matrix is developed by Yardi Systems Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
